shloka_text: शृणु राजन्महासत्व यदर्थमहमागतः । पितामहेन देवेन प्रेषितो ऽस्मि महाबल ।। 7.104.1 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu rājanmahāsatva yadarthamahamāgataḥ | pitāmahena devena preṣito 'smi mahābala || 7.104.1 ||
translation: शृणु Listen, राजन् O King, महासत्व O greatly courageous one, यदर्थम् for what purpose, अहम् I, आगतः have come, पितामहेन by the grandfather, देवेन the god, प्रेषितः sent, अस्मि I am, महाबल O mighty-armed one.
explanation: The sage then began, asking Rama to listen, and revealed that he had been sent by the divine grandfather Brahma for a specific purpose.
comments: The messenger reveals himself as Time, sent by Brahma to tell Rama that his ordained span as Vishnu among men is fulfilled and that the grandfather summons him to return, whether to rule on or come back to the gods -- and Rama, smiling, accepts that his time has come and resolves to depart.

shloka_text: तवाहं पूर्वसद्भावे पुत्रः परपुरञ्जय । मायासम्भावितो वीर कालः सर्वसमाहरः ।। 7.104.2 ।।
transliteration: tavāhaṃ pūrvasadbhāve putraḥ parapurañjaya | māyāsambhāvito vīra kālaḥ sarvasamāharaḥ || 7.104.2 ||
translation: तव your, अहम् I, पूर्वसद्भावे in a previous existence, पुत्रः son, परपुरञ्जय O conqueror of enemy cities, मायासम्भावितः created by Maya, वीर O hero, कालः Time, सर्वसमाहरः the destroyer of all.
explanation: O conqueror of enemy cities, O hero, I am your son from a previous existence, created by your divine power as Time, the destroyer of all.

shloka_text: पितामहश्च भगवानाह लोकपतिः प्रभुः । समयस्ते कृतः सौम्य लोकान्सम्परिरक्षितुम् ।। 7.104.3 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahaśca bhagavānāha lokapatiḥ prabhuḥ | samayaste kṛtaḥ saumya lokānsamparirakṣitum || 7.104.3 ||
translation: पितामहः Grandfather Brahma, च and, भगवान् the revered one, आह said, लोकपतिः lord of the worlds, प्रभुः the mighty one, समयः an agreement, ते by you, कृतः made, सौम्य O gentle one, लोकान् the worlds, सम्परिरक्षितुम् to protect well.
explanation: And the revered Grandfather Brahma, the mighty lord of the worlds, said, "O gentle one, an agreement has been made by you to protect the worlds well."

shloka_text: सङ्क्षिप्य हि पुरा लोकान्मायया स्वयमेव हि । महार्णवे शयानो ऽप्सु मां त्वं पूर्वमजीजनः ।। 7.104.4 ।।
transliteration: saṅkṣipya hi purā lokānmāyayā svayameva hi | mahārṇave śayāno 'psu māṃ tvaṃ pūrvamajījanaḥ || 7.104.4 ||
translation: सङ्क्षिप्य having dissolved, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, लोकान् the worlds, मायया by Maya, स्वयमेव by yourself alone, हि indeed, महार्णवे in the great ocean, शयानः lying, अप्सु in the waters, माम् me, त्वम् you, पूर्वम् formerly, अजीजनः begot.
explanation: Indeed, formerly, having dissolved the worlds by your own divine power, you lay in the great ocean and begot me in the waters.

shloka_text: भोगवन्तं ततो नागमनन्तमुदकेशयम् । मायया जनयित्वा त्वं द्वौ च सत्त्वौ महाबलौ ।। 7.104.5 ।।
transliteration: bhogavantaṃ tato nāgamanantamudakeśayam | māyayā janayitvā tvaṃ dvau ca sattvau mahābalau || 7.104.5 ||
translation: भोगवन्तम् having hoods, ततः then, नागम् the serpent, अनन्तम् Ananta, उदकेशयम् lying in the water, मायया by Maya, जनयित्वा having created, त्वम् you, द्वौ two, च and, सत्त्वौ beings, महाबलौ very powerful.
explanation: Then, having created by your divine power the hooded serpent Ananta, who lies in the water, you also created two very powerful beings.

shloka_text: मधुं च कैटभं चैव ययोरस्थिचयैर्वृता । इयं पर्वतसम्बाधा मेदिनी चाभवन्मही ।। 7.104.6 ।।
transliteration: madhuṃ ca kaiṭabhaṃ caiva yayorasthicayairvṛtā | iyaṃ parvatasambādhā medinī cābhavanmahī || 7.104.6 ||
translation: मधुम् Madhu, च and, कैटभम् Kaitabha, च and, एव indeed, ययोः whose, अस्थिचयैः by heaps of bones, वृता covered, इयम् this, पर्वतसम्बाधा crowded with mountains, मेदिनी the earth, च and, अभवत् became, मही the great earth.
explanation: These two were Madhu and Kaitabha, whose heaps of bones covered this earth, which then became the great earth crowded with mountains.

shloka_text: पद्मे दिव्ये ऽर्कसङ्काशे नाभ्यामुत्पाद्य मामपि । प्राजापत्यं त्वया कर्म मयि सर्वं निवेशितम् ।। 7.104.7 ।।
transliteration: padme divye 'rkasaṅkāśe nābhyāmutpādya māmapi | prājāpatyaṃ tvayā karma mayi sarvaṃ niveśitam || 7.104.7 ||
translation: पद्मे on the lotus, दिव्ये divine, अर्कसङ्काशे sun-like, नाभ्याम् from the navel, उत्पाद्य having created, माम् me, अपि also, प्राजापत्यम् of creation, त्वया by you, कर्म work, मयि in me, सर्वम् all, निवेशितम् entrusted.
explanation: Having created me from your divine, sun-like lotus navel, you entrusted all the work of creation to me.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं सन्न्यस्तभारो हि त्वामुपासे जगत्पतिम् । रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान् ।। 7.104.8 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ sannyastabhāro hi tvāmupāse jagatpatim | rakṣāṃ vidhatsva bhūteṣu mama tejaskaro bhavān || 7.104.8 ||
translation: सः that, अहम् I, सन्न्यस्तभारः having relinquished the burden, हि indeed, त्वाम् you, उपासे I worship, जगत्पतिम् the lord of the world, रक्षाम् protection, विधत्स्व bestow, भूतेषु for beings, मम my, तेजस्करः increasing the splendor, भवान् you.
explanation: Having indeed relinquished that burden, I now worship you, the Lord of the world; please bestow protection upon all beings and increase my splendor.

translation: ततः then, त्वम् you, अपि also, दुर्धर्षात् from the unassailable, तस्मात् from that, भावात् state, सनातनात् eternal, रक्षार्थम् for the protection, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, विष्णुत्वम् the state of Vishnu, उपजग्मिवान् attained.
explanation: Therefore, you also, from that unassailable and eternal state, assumed the form of Vishnu for the protection of all beings.

shloka_text: अदित्यां वीर्यवान्पुत्रो भ्रातऽणां वीर्यवर्धनः । समुत्पन्नेषु कृत्येषु तेषां साह्याय कल्पसे ।। 7.104.10 ।।
transliteration: adityāṃ vīryavānputro bhrāta'ṇāṃ vīryavardhanaḥ | samutpanneṣu kṛtyeṣu teṣāṃ sāhyāya kalpase || 7.104.10 ||
translation: अदित्याम् in Aditi, वीर्यवान् powerful, पुत्रः son, भ्रातॄणाम् of brothers, वीर्यवर्धनः increasing the valor, समुत्पन्नेषु when arisen, कृत्येषु in difficulties, तेषाम् their, साह्याय for help, कल्पसे you become capable.
explanation: As a powerful son born to Aditi, increasing the valor of your brothers, you become capable of assisting them when difficulties arise.

shloka_text: स त्वं वित्रास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतां वर । रावणस्य वधाकाङ्क्षी मानुषेषु मनो ऽदधाः ।। 7.104.11 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ vitrāsyamānāsu prajāsu jagatāṃ vara | rāvaṇasya vadhākāṅkṣī mānuṣeṣu mano 'dadhāḥ || 7.104.11 ||
translation: सः that, त्वम् you, वित्रास्यमानासु when being terrified, प्रजासु the creatures, जगताम् of the worlds, वर O best one, रावणस्य of Ravana, वधाकाङ्क्षी desiring the slaying, मानुषेषु among humans, मनः mind, अदधाः you set.
explanation: O best of the worlds, when the creatures were being terrified, you, desiring the slaying of Ravana, set your mind on being born among humans.

shloka_text: दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च । कृत्वा वासस्य नियतिं स्वयमेवात्मना पुरा ।। 7.104.12 ।।
transliteration: daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca | kṛtvā vāsasya niyatiṃ svayamevātmanā purā || 7.104.12 ||
translation: दश ten, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, वर्षशतानि hundreds of years, च and, कृत्वा having fixed, वासस्य of dwelling, नियतिं the duration, स्वयमेव by yourself, आत्मना by yourself, पुरा formerly
explanation: Formerly, you yourself fixed the duration of your dwelling (on earth) for ten thousand and ten hundred years.

shloka_text: स त्वं मनोमयः पुत्रः पूर्णायुर्मानुषेष्विह । कालो ऽयं ते नरश्रेष्ठ समीपमुपवर्तितुम् ।। 7.104.13 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ manomayaḥ putraḥ pūrṇāyurmānuṣeṣviha | kālo 'yaṃ te naraśreṣṭha samīpamupavartitum || 7.104.13 ||
translation: स that, त्वं you, मनोमयः born of mind, पुत्रः son, पूर्णायुः having completed your lifespan, मानुषेषु among humans, इह here, कालः time, अयम् this, ते for you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, समीपम् proximity, उपवर्तितुम् to return
explanation: O best among men, you, the mind-born son, have completed your lifespan among humans here, and now it is time for you to return to my proximity.

shloka_text: यदि भूयो महाराज प्रजा इच्छस्युपासितुम् । वस वा वीर भद्रं त एवमाह पितामहः ।। 7.104.14 ।।
transliteration: yadi bhūyo mahārāja prajā icchasyupāsitum | vasa vā vīra bhadraṃ ta evamāha pitāmahaḥ || 7.104.14 ||
translation: यदि if, भूयः again, महाराज O great king, प्रजाः subjects, इच्छसि you desire, उपासितुम् to rule, वस dwell, वा or, वीर O hero, भद्रं welfare, ते for you, एवम् thus, आह said, पितामहः the grandfather
explanation: The grandfather (Brahma) said, "O great king, if you desire to rule your subjects again, or if you wish to stay, O hero, may good fortune be upon you."

shloka_text: अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव । सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः ।। 7.104.15 ।।
transliteration: atha vā vijigīṣā te suralokāya rāghava | sanāthā viṣṇunā devā bhavantu vigatajvarāḥ || 7.104.15 ||
translation: अथ now, वा or, विजिगीषा desire to go, ते your, सुरलोकाय to the world of gods, राघव O Raghava, सनाथाः protected, विष्णुना by Vishnu, देवाः the gods, भवन्तु may they be, विगतज्वराः free from anxiety
explanation: Or, O Raghava, if you desire to return to the world of the gods, then may the gods be protected by Vishnu and be free from all distress.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तं वाक्यं कालसमीरितम् । राघवः प्रहसन्वाक्यं सर्वसंहारमब्रवीत् ।। 7.104.16 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā pitāmahenoktaṃ vākyaṃ kālasamīritam | rāghavaḥ prahasanvākyaṃ sarvasaṃhāramabravīt || 7.104.16 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, पितामहेन by the grandfather, उक्तं spoken, वाक्यं words, कालसमीरितम् prompted by time, राघवः Rama, प्रहसन् smiling, वाक्यं words, सर्वसंहारम् indicating the dissolution of everything, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Having heard the words spoken by the grandfather, which indicated the end of his time, Rama smiled and spoke words signifying the dissolution of everything.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा मे देवदेवस्य वाक्यं परममद्भुतम् । प्रीतिर्हि महती जाता तवागमनसम्भवा ।। 7.104.17 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā me devadevasya vākyaṃ paramamadbhutam | prītirhi mahatī jātā tavāgamanasambhavā || 7.104.17 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, मे my, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, वाक्यं word, परमम् supreme, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रीतिः joy, हि indeed, महती great, जाता arisen, तव your, आगमन coming, सम्भवा caused by.
explanation: Having heard the supreme and wonderful words of the god of gods, a great joy has indeed arisen in me, caused by your arrival.

shloka_text: त्रयाणामपि लोकानां कार्यार्थं मम सम्भवः । भद्रं ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामि यत एवाहमागतः ।। 7.104.18 ।।
transliteration: trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ kāryārthaṃ mama sambhavaḥ | bhadraṃ te 'stu gamiṣyāmi yata evāhamāgataḥ || 7.104.18 ||
translation: त्रयाणाम् of the three, अपि even, लोकानाम् of worlds, कार्यार्थम् for the purpose, मम my, सम्भवः existence, भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, गमिष्यामि I shall go, यतः from where, एव indeed, अहम् I, आगतः came.
explanation: My existence is for the purpose of the three worlds; may good fortune be to you, I shall now depart to the place from where I came.

shloka_text: हद्गतो ह्यसि सम्प्राप्तो न मे तत्र विचारणा । मया हि सर्वकृत्येषु देवानां वशवर्तिनाम् । स्थातव्यं सर्वसंहार यथा ह्याह पितामहः ।। 7.104.19 ।।
transliteration: hadgato hyasi samprāpto na me tatra vicāraṇā | mayā hi sarvakṛtyeṣu devānāṃ vaśavartinām | sthātavyaṃ sarvasaṃhāra yathā hyāha pitāmahaḥ || 7.104.19 ||
translation: हद्गतः understood, हि indeed, असि you are, सम्प्राप्तः reached, न not, मे my, तत्र there, विचारणा deliberation, मया by me, हि indeed, सर्वकृत्येषु in all duties, देवानाम् of the gods, वशवर्तिनाम् obedient, स्थातव्यम् must be acted, सर्वसंहार the destruction of all, यथा as, हि indeed, आह said, पितामहः the grandfather.
explanation: You are indeed understood and your time has arrived, there is no doubt in my mind about that; for I must indeed act in all duties, obedient to the gods, for the destruction of all, just as the grandfather Brahma has indeed commanded. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 104 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
